name: trojan-reality-tcp-flow
why: A Trojan client carrying a stored XTLS flow. The pinned core removed Flow for Trojan and answers one with PrintRemovedFeatureError, which fails the whole config — so the field must reach neither the generated inbound nor the link. The stream is otherwise the exact shape that DOES allow a flow for VLESS (tcp + reality), which is what makes this fixture worth having: it pins the protocol half of the rule, not the transport half.
